description: An abstract class for producing connection event notifications based on a DownstreamSender, handling connection and disconnection events for devices.

classes.name: AbstractMessageSenderConnectionEventProducer
classes.description: An abstract class that produces connection event notifications using a downstream sender, handling connection and disconnection events.

methods.name: connected
methods.description: Handles a device connection event by sending a 'connected' notification.

methods.name: disconnected
methods.description: Handles a device disconnection event by sending a 'disconnected' notification.

methods.name: sendNotificationEvent
methods.description: Constructs and sends a connection event notification with specified cause ('connected' or 'disconnected').

methods.name: getOrCreateSender
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a downstream sender for a given tenant.
